verdict: FAIL - CRITICAL OR HIGH DEFECTS FOUND

findings.title: Discouraged Research Owner+Moderator passes with warning only
findings.expected: Blocking error requiring documented Product Owner combination review
findings.impact: An unreviewed discouraged accountability conflict can pass validation
findings.correction: Promote unresolved discouraged combinations to blocking; require PO approval evidence

findings.title: Discouraged Data Custodian+Analyst passes with warning only
findings.expected: Blocking error requiring documented Product Owner review
findings.impact: Raw-record access plus interpretation can pass without review

findings.title: Boolean evidence flag without evidence reference accepted
findings.actual: valid=True; evidence_separation_documented=true with no evidence reference
findings.impact: Conditional evidence condition can be fabricated by a boolean
findings.correction: Require structured evidence reference with source, date and approver

findings.title: Explicit Continue/Stop flag without evidence accepted
findings.actual: valid=True; explicit_additional_appointment=true with no evidence reference
findings.expected: Blocking error requiring explicit PO appointment evidence
findings.impact: Research Owner can appear to authorize Continue/Stop without a decision record
findings.correction: Require appointment evidence reference and timestamp

findings.title: Compatible multi-role assignment without PO combination approval passes
findings.expected: Blocking error: all multi-role assignments require explicit PO documentation
findings.impact: Unauthorized role combinations can be validated as complete
findings.correction: Add general combination_approval requirement for every person with >1 role

findings.title: Duplicate candidate identifier across roles accepted
findings.actual: valid=True; MODERATOR and ANALYST share P-DUP
findings.impact: Accountability and access attribution become ambiguous
findings.correction: Check candidate_id uniqueness across roles or require explicit identity mapping

findings.title: Unknown human reference accepted
findings.file: engine/validator.py; schema assignment.person_id is unconstrained string
findings.expected: Blocking error unless identity is verified against an authoritative roster
findings.impact: Formal accountability can be attached to a non-existent or unknown person
findings.correction: Add roster reference validation or mark UNASSIGNED until roster exists

findings.title: PROPOSED role treated as appointed
findings.actual: valid=True; MODERATOR state PROPOSED with candidate_id and assignment
findings.expected: Blocking error: PROPOSED is not an appointment
findings.impact: A merely proposed role can pass as a complete assignment
findings.correction: Add PROPOSED to missing_appointment_states or require formal state

findings.title: FORMALLY_APPOINTED with approval.formal=false accepted
findings.impact: Formal state can contradict formal approval evidence

findings.title: Empty Product Owner decision basis accepted
findings.impact: PO approval can be asserted without traceable basis
findings.correction: Require non-empty evidence reference and timestamp

findings.title: No structured decision timestamps
findings.input: original fixtures contain no timestamp fields
findings.actual: No timestamp fields exist; no audit check possible
findings.expected: Decision, acceptance and appointment timestamps required
findings.impact: Auditability and ordering of appointments cannot be verified
findings.correction: Add timestamp fields to schema and state requirements

findings.title: Unapproved topology does not block Stage B readiness
findings.expected: Stage B readiness blocked until topology approved
findings.impact: A proposed staffing model can appear validation-complete
findings.correction: Separate topology readiness from appointment validity; emit explicit Stage B status

findings.title: Duplicate JSON keys silently resolved last-wins
findings.impact: Conflicting state records can be silently accepted
findings.correction: Use object_pairs_hook to detect duplicate keys

findings.title: Malformed JSON produces unhandled traceback
findings.impact: Poor operator experience and unstable machine output
findings.correction: Catch json.JSONDecodeError and emit stable error

findings.title: Missing input file produces unhandled traceback
findings.correction: Catch OSError and emit stable error
